arabic text: KYUN KAR JUDA HUWA SARE SARWAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: PLEASE RECITE A SURAH FATEHA FOR THE MARHUMEEN OF ALL WHO MADE THIS TRANSLATION POSSIBLE

arabic text: KYUN KAR JUDA HUWA SARE SARWAR NA BHULNA\nGHAM SHAHE DEEN KA AY DILE MUZTAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: NEVER FORGET, WHY THE MASTER (HUSSAIN) WAS DECAPITATED (IN GOD'S WAY)\nO AGGRIEVED HEART! NEVER FORGET, THE SORROW OF THE LEADER OF FAITH (HUSSAIN)

arabic text: JALDI BULANA KEHTI THI SUGHRA PADAR SE YEH\nHALE MARIZ AY MERE SARWAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: SUGHRA USED TO PLEAD, FATHER PLEASE CALL FOR ME (TO JOIN YOU) QUICKLY\nNEVER FORGET ABOUT THE STATE OF YOUR ILL-DAUGHTER

arabic text: KYUN KAR JUDA HUWA SARE SARWAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: NEVER FORGET, WHY THE MASTER (HUSSAIN) WAS DECAPITATED (IN GOD'S WAY)

arabic text: KEHTI THI LAYLA BETE KI ZULFE SANWAR KAR\nMERA RIYAZ AY ALI AKBAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: LAYLA USED TO SAY, WHILE COMBING HER SON'S HAIR\nNEVER FORGET MY DEVOTIONAL-CARE, O ALI AKBAR

arabic text: BACHE KO LEKAR JAB CHALE SHABBIR KHAIME ME\nMAA BOLI MERI MEHNATEI ASGHAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: WHEN SHABBIR LEFT THE TENTS, WITH THE INFANT IN HAND\nTHE MOTHER SAID, O ASGHAR DON'T FORGET ALL MY NURTURING (IN READYING YOU FOR YOUR ROLE)

arabic text: KEHTHI THI YEH TASAWURE ASGHAR MEI RO KE MAA\nDADI KE PAS PEHLU E MADAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: ASGHAR'S MOTHER USED TO SAY THIS IN HER INNER THOUGHTS\nDON'T FORGET YOUR MOTHER'S LOVE, IN YOUR GRANDMOTHER'S LAP

arabic text: KEHTA THA SHIMRE CHADAARE ZAYNAB UTAAR KE\nAY DIL KAHIN SAKINA KE GUHAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: SHIMR WOULD SAY, UPON SNATCHING ZAINAB'S VEIL\nO SELF! DON'T FORGET SAKINA'S EARRINGS, TOO

arabic text: MAA KEHTI THI KE YAAD RAHE MERI TISHNAGI\nKAUSAR PE MUJH KO AY ALI ASGHAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: THE MOTHER USED TO SAY, REMEMBER MY THIRST,\nO ASGHAR, DON'T FORGET ME AT THE POOL OF KAWTHAR

arabic text: KEHTA THA IBNE SAAD KE TURBAT KO KHOD KAR\nAY SHIMR KAATANA SARE ASGHAR NA BHULNA
english translation text: THE SON OF SAAD WOULD SAY DIGGING UP THE GRAVES\nO SHIMR, DON'T FORGET TO SEVER ASGHAR'S HEAD (TOO)
